description: This file contains serializers and copiers for the KeyValuePair<TKey, TValue> type, including classes for serialization (KeyValuePairCodec) and deep copying (KeyValuePairCopier). It is part of the Orleans.Serialization.Codecs namespace and implements custom serialization logic for key-value pairs.

classes.name: KeyValuePairCodec<TKey, TValue>
classes.description: Serializer for KeyValuePair<TKey, TValue> that handles writing and reading key-value pairs to and from a wire format.

classes.name: KeyValuePairCopier<TKey, TValue>
classes.description: Deep copier for KeyValuePair<TKey, TValue> that supports shallow and deep copying.

methods.name: WriteField
methods.description: Serializes a KeyValuePair<TKey, TValue> to a buffer, writing the key and value fields.

methods.name: ReadValue
methods.description: Deserializes a KeyValuePair<TKey, TValue> from a buffer, reading key and value fields.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of a KeyValuePair<TKey, TValue> instance, using optional copiers for key and value.
